title: Machine Learning as a Precision-Medicine Approach to Prescribing COVID-19 Pharmacotherapy with Remdesivir or Corticosteroids.
summary: Among 2,364 patients, no overall survival-time association was found; algorithm-identified subgroups showed adjusted associations for both treatments, supported by later-admission evaluation. The subgroup findings are observational; they do not establish causal response or benefit from model-guided care.
ai_technology: Gradient-boosted decision-tree models used electronic health records from ten hospitals to identify COVID-19 patients in whom remdesivir or corticosteroid treatment was observationally associated with survival time.
